title: 2008 HMMT February Combinatorics Problem 1
statement: A \(3 \times 3 \times 3\) cube composed of 27 unit cubes rests on a horizontal plane. Determine the number of ways of selecting two distinct unit cubes from a \(3 \times 3 \times 1\) block (the order is irrelevant) with the property that the line joining the centers of the two cubes makes a \(45^{\circ}\) angle with the horizontal plane.

solutions.text: 60 There are 6 such slices, and each slice gives 10 valid pairs (with no overcounting). Therefore, there are 60 such pairs.
